summary: Millrose Properties filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026, announcing its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.79 per share on Class A and Class B common stock, totaling roughly $131.2 million, payable October 15, 2026 to holders of record October 5, 2026. The disclosure appears under Items 7.01 and 8.01 with the press release as Exhibit 99.1. No advisor or board recommendation beyond the declaration is named. This is a routine capital-return event, not a special situation; the key watch item is dividend sustainability tied to the homesite option platform's cash generation.
